d: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, has come under scrutiny after a report by India Today’s Kaushik Deka flagged 55 factual and contextual errors in the book. From the foundation year of the RSS and Ahmed Patel’s death to the 2014 Lok Sabha election results and the Kargil War timeline, several details reportedly do not match historical records. The report also highlights errors related to the Rajya Sabha’s election process and Rahul Gandhi’s defamation case. While the book offers personal insights into the Gandhi family, these reported discrepancies have raised questions…
